address.docs:
**int**: Manually specify the I²C address of the sensor. Defaults to `0x7F`.

*See also: [XIDIBEI XDB401 Pressure Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/xdb401#configuration-variables)*

pressure.docs:
The measured pressure in Pascal (Pa). All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [XIDIBEI XDB401 Pressure Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/xdb401#configuration-variables)*

pressure_range_bar.docs:
**int**: The maximum pressure range of your sensor model in bar. One of `1`, `2`, `5`, `10`, `20`, `50`, `100`. Defaults to `10`.

*See also: [XIDIBEI XDB401 Pressure Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/xdb401#configuration-variables)*

temperature.docs:
The measured temperature in °C. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [XIDIBEI XDB401 Pressure Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/xdb401#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to check the sensor. Defaults to `60s`.

*See also: [XIDIBEI XDB401 Pressure Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/xdb401#configuration-variables)*
